listing.name: Bannerlord Player Flags
listing.summary: Been on a Bannerlord kick lately and this was one of the first things I thought of. Can't find the Nordvyg faction flag asset; if anyone has that lying around, let me know and I'll update this. This is also my first mod to support icons at launch!
